text:
maya: quick check — I refactored the payments TF module to split iam + k8s resources into separate modules. PR: https://git.redwood/payments/pull/424. before i merge: do we want provider pins in the root only or keep module-level pins? also, how should we wire the k8s service account secret name from module -> cluster manifest?

kevin: if possible hoist provider versions to root and pass provider instances into modules via the providers map. modules should `required_providers` but avoid `version` pin inside the module to keep upgrade control centralized. :+1:

maya: here's the minimal snippet from root and module: 
```
# root
provider "aws" {
  region  = "us-west-2"
  version = "~> 4.60"
}

# module usage
module "payments" {
  source = "../modules/payments"
  providers = { aws = aws }
}
```

oliver: that looks ok. if you need multi-region, use provider aliases and pass them explicitly: `providers = { aws = aws.us_west }`. Also run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64,linux_arm64` in CI so the lockfile is deterministic across agents.

li: for the k8s SA secret wiring — the module that creates the SA returns `sa_name` and `sa_token_secret_name` (we do this via controller). in your cluster manifest reference it like `secretName: ${module.payments.sa_token_secret_name}`. if it's across stacks, expose a `data "kubernetes_secret"` lookup in the cluster stack. avoid hardcoding secret paths.

maya: getting a weird plan error when modules declare `provider "aws" {}` inside them (no alias) — terraform says duplicate provider configurations. i assumed hoisting would fix it. any quick commands to fix state?

kevin: if modules were created with their own provider configs you might need `terraform state replace-provider` or `terraform state mv` to move resources to the hoisted provider. e.g.:
```
# in the module workspace
terraform state replace-provider registry.terraform.io/-/aws registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws
```

or move individual resources: `terraform state mv module.payments.aws_iam_role.myrole module.payments.aws_iam_role.myrole` (awkward but sometimes needed). do this in a controlled window.

devops-bot: CI: staging plan for branch payments-refactor succeeded (plan id: plan-782). Lockfile diff: updated required_providers stanza -> pinned at ~>4.60 for aws. Link: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/782/plan

sre-oncall: quick Q — will this require rolling deploys for the payments pods? if the SA name changes we may need a restart. include rollout notes in PR.

maya: SA name unchanged, just moving creation into payments/iam module. I'll include a `kubectl rollout restart deployment/payments` in the post-merge job to be safe. also adding a note about the `terraform state replace-provider` steps in the PR description.

oliver: one more nit — run `terraform fmt` and `validate` in the PR CI and add a short comment in the module README explaining provider expectations (hoisted only). after that i'm fine to LGT M.

kevin: LGTM from me too once CI passes. please also run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` locally and commit the `.terraform.lock.hcl` to avoid CI surprises.

maya: thanks all — will push the small doc change and the lockfile. merging after green CI. :shipit:
